status: model-derived onset candidates only; neither human listening nor acoustic ground truth
method: Every cue was independently forced through MMS_FA and English wav2vec2 CTC in a bounded exact-source mix crop [cue start - 0.55 s, cue end + 0.35 s]. Word labels were normalized to letters for the acoustic models. A positive model-minus-preview delta means the model places the word later than the current preview. The original candidate timeline was derived from Whisper small and large-v3-turbo; these extra families are comparison evidence only. A second MMS_FA pass used an htdemucs vocal-only stem spanning source t=42–164 s, resampled to 16 kHz mono. The stem pass uses the same acoustic-model family as the mix pass, not an independent model vote.
limitations: A forced path can place words that are absent or acoustically obscured.
The English wav2vec2 greedy decoding was largely nonsensical on this musical mix, with many low word probabilities; its forced times are weak evidence unless a phonetic/vocal check agrees.
MMS scores are uncalibrated for source-sung English and instrument bleed; low scores weaken onset claims.
These candidates do not measure human perception, distinguish singer from backing/instrument transients, or justify shifting the timeline without direct audio and preview review.
Demucs source separation may suppress or shift low-level consonants and backing voices; mix and vocal-stem MMS agreement is still only one model-family observation.
